theme: Young investor / first-timer: starting early, small amounts, ₹500/month
headline: Start investing young with just ₹500
body: Begin your investment journey early. Small regular amounts compound into significant wealth over decades of growth.
caption: Young investors have time as their greatest asset. Starting with ₹500 monthly teaches discipline and builds wealth through consistency. Beginning early means your money works longer. #StartSmall #InvestYoung #CompoundGrowth #MoneyHabits #WealthBuilding
